subject: Architecture
title: The Pantheon: Rome's Perfect Circle
description: A 60-second lesson on The Pantheon: Rome's Perfect Circle.

hook.text: The Pantheon's dome has a 30-foot hole in the top. It was designed that way on purpose.

buildup.text: The oculus is the only source of light. Rain falls through it onto the gently sloped floor.

discovery.text: The dome's height and diameter are identical — 142 feet — creating a perfect sphere inside.

twist.text: It's nearly 2,000 years old and still the world's largest unreinforced concrete dome.

climax.text: Michelangelo called it 'the work of angels, not men.' He then based St. Peter's dome on it.

punchline.text: Two millennia later, nobody has built a bigger one without steel.

quiz.question: What is special about the Pantheon's dome dimensions?
options: It is the tallest dome ever constructed
Its height and diameter are identical, forming a perfect sphere
It is built entirely of marble blocks
